definitions.explanation: The government body or process responsible for investigating crimes and bringing criminal charges in court.

examples.japanese: {検察|けんさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}した→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧。
{検察|けんさつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}する→起訴する：09863_kisosuru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧だ。
examples.english: The prosecution plans to indict the suspect.

examples.japanese: {検察|けんさつ}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{証人|しょうにん}→証人：18845_shounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{法廷|ほうてい}→法廷：15113_houtei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A witness for the prosecution testified in court.

notes:
USAGE:
{検察|けんさつ} can refer to both the prosecution as an institution and the act of prosecuting. In Japan, prosecutors (⟦{検察官|けんさつかん}→検察官：09664_kensatsukan⟧ or ⟦{検事|けんじ}→検事：20788_kenji⟧) belong to the {検察庁|けんさつちょう} (Public Prosecutors Office).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検察|けんさつ}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (the prosecution side)
- {検察|けんさつ}{官|かん} (prosecutor)
- {検察|けんさつ}{庁|ちょう} (Public Prosecutors Office)
- {検察|けんさつ}{審査会|しんさかい} (Prosecution Review Commission)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{検事|けんじ}→検事：20788_kenji⟧ (public prosecutor — the individual)
- ⟦{弁護|べんご}→弁護：10579_bengo⟧ (defense)
